newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-POPPLEWELL FINED FOR PUNCHING PLAYER.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-POPPLEWELL FINED FOR PUNCHING PLAYER.

text.p: Ireland rugby union international prop Nick Popplewell has been fined by his club Newcastle for throwing a punch at Bedford's Scott Murray in an English league match last weekend.

Murray was forced to leave the field with blurred vision after the incident during the division two promotion clash. Popplewell was shown a yellow card by referee Steve Lander but Bedford urged Newcastle to watch a video to judge if further action was needed.
Newcastle issued a statement on Wednesday saying Popplewell had been fined and warned as to his future conduct.
The amount of the fine was not announced but was believed to be around 1,000 pounds ($1,620).
Bedford coach Paul Turner welcomed Newcastle's action. "I commend their actions. Newcastle have done the right thing by putting their own house in order," he said.

Popplewell, a former British Lion who narrowly missed selection for the forthcoming tour of South Africa, was deemed fortunate by many spectators not to have been sent off. If he had been, he would have faced a one-month automatic suspension.
